messages.subject: [Rpy] rpy2 3.2.5 is released.
messages.body_plain:
#rpy2 <https://twitter.com/hashtag/rpy2?src=hashtag_click> 3.2.5 is
released and on pypi. It fixes a breaking change upstream (latest R package
`rlang`) and should make it work again with Python 3.5.

https://rpy2.github.io/doc/v3.2.x/html/changes.html#release-3-2-5
<https://t.co/PEOclwQobF?amp=1>

messages.subject: [Rpy] Deleting old doc pages for rpy2-2.0.x from Sourceforge
messages.subject_clean: [Rpy] Deleting old doc pages for rpy2-2.0.x from Sourceforge
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

The old doc pages for rpy2-2.0.x are being deleted from Sourceforge. Search
engines are still returning these pages in results and this is creating
confusion among users.

Best,

Laurent
